tool_signatures.name: email_transfer
tool_signatures.description: Move or copy emails BETWEEN accounts, preserving the original message intact (sender, date, threading) by transferring the raw MIME. Fetches each message from the source account and imports it into the target account. With deleteAfter=true the source copy is sent to trash only after a confirmed import, making this a safe cross-account move.

targetFolder.description: Destination folder/label in the target account (Gmail label id or name; IMAP/Outlook folder name). Defaults to INBOX.

sourceFolder.description: Source folder (required for IMAP/iCloud when emails are not in INBOX)

deleteAfter.description: Send the source copy to trash after a successful import. Default false (copy, leaving the original in place).

markRead.description: Mark imported messages as read in the target. Default: provider default (usually unread).

parameters.name: deleteAfter
parameters.description: Send the source copy to trash after a successful import. Default false (copy, leaving the original in place).

parameters.name: emailIds
parameters.description: Source email IDs to transfer

parameters.name: markRead
parameters.description: Mark imported messages as read in the target. Default: provider default (usually unread).

parameters.name: sourceAccountId
parameters.description: Account to read messages from

parameters.name: sourceFolder
parameters.description: Source folder (required for IMAP/iCloud when emails are not in INBOX)

parameters.name: targetAccountId
parameters.description: Account to import messages into

parameters.name: targetFolder
parameters.description: Destination folder/label in the target account (Gmail label id or name; IMAP/Outlook folder name). Defaults to INBOX.
